summary: Galera Therapeutics, Inc. disclosed its board-approved 1-for-200 reverse stock split, effective July 12, 2026, with split-adjusted trading starting July 13, 2026. Every 200 pre-split shares convert to one post-split share; fractional shares cashed out at the OTCQB closing price on the last trading day prior to effective date. The split proportionally reduces shares available under equity plans, outstanding stock options, and warrants, with corresponding exercise price adjustments. This reverse stock split is a capital-structure event to comply with listing standards. Watch for subsequent bid price compliance; no risk-arb opportunity.
